teaser: The flickering exit sign over the gym doors never gets fixed, because everyone assumes someone else owns it until you decide you do. You are a life path 1, wired to lead and go first, carrying an ESFP's instinct for what's happening right now in the room it's standing in. The 1 wants a will that doesn't wait on consensus; the ESFP wants to be where the people are, feeling out what the moment needs before anyone says it out loud. Put those in one person and you get someone who leads from inside the crowd rather than above it, deciding fast, acting faster, trusting the plan to catch up to the instinct, or not need to.
